subject: GreenPoint CAIQ: narrative responses and evidence handoff
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@greenpoint.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: security@greenpoint.com
Date: 2027-03-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ follow-up & evidence requests for initial assessment

Hi Vanessa / Marissa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. GreenPoint is starting the CAIQ intake for our vendor review and we have a short list of narrative items and evidence samples we need from Redwood to move to our risk committee on 3/24. Please see the attached spreadsheet (GreenPoint_CAIQ_Request_v1.xlsx) — we've highlighted ~18 control statements where we need:

- short narrative (1-3 sentences) describing how the control is implemented in Redwood's hosted and private deployments
- the primary control owner (role) and an artifact sample (log snippet, diagram, policy excerpt)

Top asks: KMS key rotation proof for Private deployments, a network diagram showing tenant routing boundaries, and retention/archival policy text for inference telemetry. If you can provide a draft mapping and a handful of artifacts by 3/18 EOD, that would keep us on track.

Can you confirm owners for the items in rows 2-10? Also, any objections to sharing an anonymized runtime log sample (we'll sanitize customer IDs) for the CCM-TELEMETRY questions?

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Alice

--
Alice Chen
Senior Vendor Risk Analyst, GreenPoint Financial
security@greenpoint.com
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@greenpoint.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2027-03-16T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ follow-up & evidence requests for initial assessment

Alice — thanks for the clear ask and spreadsheet. We're on it. High level:

- Owners: Marissa will lead the CAIQ narrative and evidence collection; Rishi will own anything telemetry/runtime related; Kimberly will lead anything crypto/KMS.
- Timeline: draft mapping + selected artifacts to you by 2027-03-18 COB. If we hit any items that require legal review (e.g., full log samples or tenant-specific diagrams) we'll flag those immediately and propose redacted alternatives.

I've attached our working draft (Redwood_CAIQ_Mapping_Draft_20270316.xlsx) which maps your highlighted rows to our CCM/CAIQ references and the internal artifact candidates. For the runtime sample question: we can provide a sanitized KV-cache access log sample; Rishi will confirm exact fields we can include.

Quick clarifications requested from your side (so we scope artifacts correctly):
1) For questions about key rotation, do you need full rotation schedules or an HSM/KMS audit extract?
2) For network diagrams, is a high-level tenant-segmentation diagram sufficient or do you require subnet-level overlays?

We can hop on a 20m call tomorrow if that helps.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Security & Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@greenpoint.com>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2027-03-17T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ follow-up & evidence requests for initial assessment

Alice / Vanessa — attaching a short narrative pack and the artifact index. Two notes:

1) Narrative approach: for each CAIQ question we will provide a concise "What we do" (one sentence), "Where it's enforced" (one sentence), and an "Example artifact" pointer. Example for CAIQ item CCM.AS-03: "We use short-lived inference tokens and per-request rate-limiting at the gateway; enforced in the edge routing layer; see artifact: runtime_kv_cache_policy.pdf (page 2)".

2) Specific ask re: CCM-TELEMETRY-04 (you flagged row 7): our sanitized runtime sample will include timestamps, token generation latencies, and anonymized request hashes (no customer identifiers). We will not include prompt/response bodies.

Attachments included: Runtime_KV-Cache-Policy.pdf, kms-rotation-proof.txt (hash and timestamp excerpts), and the narrative pack embedded in the XLSX.

A couple of questions for GreenPoint:
- For any control that references tenant separation, do you require a separate attestation for Redwood Dedicated vs Redwood Private, or is a single narrative with callouts acceptable?
- Are the artifact formats (.pdf/.txt/.xlsx) acceptable or do you need a DocuSign/canonicalized evidence portal upload?

If that looks good we will finalize and send the redacted runtime sample by 3/18 morning.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Principal Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@greenpoint.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: security@greenpoint.com, procurement@greenpoint.com
Date: 2027-03-18T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ follow-up & evidence requests for initial assessment

Marissa / Vanessa — this is great, thanks. The artifacts you attached look fine — PDF/text/xlsx are all acceptable. A couple confirmations:

- Single narrative with callouts for Dedicated vs Private is fine for our committee (call out differences where they exist).
- For KMS rotation: an audit extract (kek rotation events + timestamps + signer) is preferred to a schedule; the kms-rotation-proof.txt looks like it will suffice if it contains the event hashes and rotation timestamps.
- Runtime sample: sanitized KV-cache log as described is acceptable. We'll route any further collection requests through procurement for the NDA/DocuSign step; procurement@greenpoint.com is CC'd.

Please send the final packaged CAIQ mapping + artifacts link (Drive or secure upload) and we'll confirm next steps. If you can get everything uploaded by EOD Friday (3/19) that keeps us aligned with the 3/24 risk committee.

Thanks,
Alice Chen
Senior Vendor Risk Analyst, GreenPoint Financial
